title: DRY scoped Pattern migration
goal: Apply the user’s DRY component workflow to all existing Patterns while preserving their behavior and portable editing.

nodes.title: Migrate existing Patterns
nodes.goal: Move all13 Patterns, shared compiler, editor, persistence and artifacts to DRY scoped authoring.
deliverables: Migrated Patterns and five-artifact Framework export
acceptanceChecks: All13 compile and round-trip; legacy drafts preserve edits; utilities precede components

nodes.title: Verify behavior and independent review
nodes.goal: Check responsive portable and authoring behavior, nested scopes, saved drafts and export contracts; review standards and user spec.
acceptanceChecks: Tests, typecheck, build, responsive browser and scope isolation checks pass; review findings resolved
